$comment: Every sentence the tools modules write to a model themselves — validation refusals, rule refusals, caveats, and the errors that have no problem document to quote. Shared so that the same failure reads the same in every language (fixtures/ compares results byte for byte). `{name}` is a placeholder, substituted verbatim; no other braces carry meaning. README.md documents when each one is used.

validation.summary: Invalid arguments: fix the listed fields and call again.
validation.not_json: Arguments are not valid JSON. Send a JSON object.
validation.not_an_object: Arguments must be a JSON object.

rules.needs_query_or_filters: Provide `query`, `filters`, or both. A search with neither has nothing to match on.
rules.auto_needs_query: `category: "auto"` asks the engine to classify your words, so it needs `query`. Name the category to search with filters alone.
rules.auto_needs_auto_mode: `category: "auto"` requires `mode: "auto"`: classification is itself a model call, and `fast` runs none. Set both, or name the category and keep `fast`.
rules.auto_takes_query_only: `category: "auto"` accepts only `query`: filters, domain lists and `sort` are category-specific. Name the category to use them.
rules.auto_conflicts_with_application: `category: "auto"` cannot apply the constraints this application sets on every search. Name the category.
rules.domains_need_entity_category: `include_domains` and `exclude_domains` apply to company, person and job_opening, not `{category}`: a document has no domain of its own.
rules.sort_duplicate_field: `sort` names `{field}` twice. Two directions for one field is a contradiction.
rules.by_not_accepted: `{category}` accepts no `by`: its ids already are record ids.
rules.person_has_no_domain: `by: "domain"` is not valid for `person`: a person has no domain. Use `li_url` or `name`.

caveats.parser_not_run: parser_not_run: `fast` mode did not parse the query, so a constraint stated only in words (a country, a headcount, an industry) was not applied. Use `mode: "auto"` or put it in `filters`.
caveats.coverage_truncated: coverage_truncated: {enumerated} of {universe} matching records were enumerated before {truncated_by} stopped it.
caveats.application_filter: application_filter: `filters.{path}` is fixed by this application to {value}; your {requested} was not applied.
caveats.limit_capped: limit_capped: you asked for {requested} rows; this application returns at most {limit} per call.
caveats.rows_without_lookup: rows_without_lookup: {count} of {shown} rows carry no domain or LinkedIn URL, so they have no `lookup` value and cannot be looked up.
caveats.anchors_unreported: anchors_unreported: the API does not report which of the {count} anchors resolved. Say the results are based on the anchors provided, not that they match every one.
caveats.anchors_by_name: anchors_by_name: {names} — resolved by name with no disambiguation, so a same-named company may have been used. Prefer a domain.
caveats.anchors_zero_weight: anchors_zero_weight: {names} — weight 0, so no influence on the result.
caveats.anchors_removed: anchors_removed: {ids} — returned as a look-alike of itself and removed.
caveats.search_ids_not_found: search_ids_not_found: {ids} — search-result ids are not record ids and are never found here. Look the row up by its `lookup` value (domain or LinkedIn URL); this miss does not mean the record is not held.
caveats.raw_values_without_by: raw_values_without_by: {ids} — read as record ids because `by` was not set. Call again with `by: "domain"` or `by: "li_url"`.
caveats.record_unavailable: record_unavailable: {ids} — resolved, but no record came back. This is not a miss.

errors.unknown_tool: No tool named `{name}` is available here. Available: {available}.
errors.timeout_sent: The request timed out after it was sent. This call is charged once the server has done the work, so a charge may already have happened; it was not repeated. Do not retry it automatically.
errors.connection_sent: The connection failed after the request was sent. This call is charged once the server has done the work, so a charge may already have happened; it was not repeated. Do not retry it automatically.
errors.connection_unsent: Could not reach the Sprouts API. The request was never sent and nothing was charged; retrying later may succeed.
errors.gateway_no_answer: A gateway answered {status} without a result. The request may have reached the service and been charged; it was not repeated. Do not retry it automatically.
errors.response_invalid: The API answered in a shape this SDK version cannot read. The call may have been charged; do not retry it.
